title: Interview with Jeffrey Shaw, Online, 11 January 2025

contacts.name: Data Steward of the Faculty of Humanities

descriptions: Online interview with Jeffrey Shaw covering his time working in the Netherlands around the 1960s to 1980s. Discussed is his collaborations with various artists and people during his time in the Netherlands, how public interactivity ties into his art practice, as well as about the construction and meaning of his early computer-based artwork, Points of View (1983). The interview was conducted in the context of a master’s thesis research.
